title: 第13章 谢剑疯了秘密似乎藏不住了第14章 杀人放火金腰带扎纸成灵
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 堂堂合欢宗内门弟子，半步筑基的天才，就这样像条死狗一样，被李长生随手捏死在了自家院子前。
片刻……
李长生松开手。
尸体扑通一声掉在地上。
他看都没看一眼。
熟练地取下沈醉的储物袋和那把白骨折扇。
然后。
想了想。
就做了一个违背道德的决定。
既然谢剑派了沈醉进来试探。
那我也可以用沈醉来试探谢剑。
李长生提起沈醉的尸体，身形一闪，消失在夜色中。
第二天清晨。
安置区的中心广场上。
一根旗杆插在中央，旗杆顶端，挂着一具尸体。
尸体身穿粉色锦袍，随风摇晃。
虽然面容已经有些扭曲，但依然能认出来，那正是昨晚闯入安置区的合欢宗弟子沈醉。
而在尸体的胸口上。
写着几个血淋淋的大字：
“合欢宗魔修。”
“该诛！”
字迹苍劲有力，透着凛冽的剑意。
最先发现的是安置区的苏员外。
苏员外祖上也是青云宗被优化的弟子，但是因为修炼资质薄弱，建立凡人家族之后，就没有再踏入仙路，而是做起了凡人的生意。
安置区的坊市中就有一大半生意都是苏家的。
苏员外正准备去自己的米仓看看，路过中央广场时，看到了这一幕，禁不住惊呼一声：
“死人了。”
“死人了啊！”
随着苏员外的惊呼，周围的老头打开门，走出来，围在中央广场上。
看着挂在高杆上的男子。
禁不住倒吸一口气。
“这是羊肉串吗？”
“将人从屁股穿进去，从嘴巴出来。这也太残忍了吧？”
“残忍个锤子。”
“难道你没有看到其身上的字吗？【合欢宗魔修】。”
“咱们安置区不是被封锁了吗？合欢宗的人怎么进来安置区的？”
“我现在只想知道是谁干的？”
“按照残留的灵力判断，合欢宗魔修应该是半步筑基修为，到底是谁杀了他？谁又有能力能杀了他？”
“难道我们安置区里，还藏着绝世高手？”
content_en:
A dignified inner disciple of the Hehuan Sect, a genius who was half-stepped to build a foundation, was casually crushed to death by Li Changsheng like a dead dog in front of his yard.
For a moment...
Li Changsheng let go of his hand.
The body plopped to the ground.
He didn't even look at it.
Skillfully removed the drunken storage bag and the white fractured fan.
Then.
Think about it.
I made an unethical decision.
Since Xie Jian sent Shen Zui in to test.
Then I can also use Shen Zui to test Xie Jian.
Li Changsheng lifted up the drunk body and disappeared into the night.
…
Early the next morning.
In the central square of the resettlement area.
A flagpole was stuck in the center, and a corpse hung on the top of the flagpole.
The corpse was wearing a pink brocade robe, swaying in the wind.
Although his face was a little distorted, he could still recognize it as Shen Zui, a disciple of the Hehuan Sect who broke into the resettlement area last night.
And on the chest of the corpse.
There were a few big bloody characters written on it:
"Hehuan Sect Demonic Cultivator."
"Deserves to be punished!"
The handwriting is vigorous and powerful, revealing the cold sword intent.
The first person to be discovered was Yuan Su outside the resettlement area.
Su Yuan's maternal ancestor was also an optimized disciple of the Qingyun Sect, but due to his weak cultivation qualifications, after establishing a mortal family, he did not set foot on the path of immortality again, but started a mortal business.
Most of the businesses in the resettlement area are owned by the Su family.
Member Su was about to go to his rice warehouse to take a look. When he passed by the central square, he saw this scene and couldn't help but exclaimed:
"Dead people."
"He's dead!"
…
Following Su Yuanwai's exclamation, the old men around him opened the door, walked out, and gathered around the central square.
Look at the man hanging on the high pole.
I couldn't help but take a breath.
"Is this mutton kebab?"
"Putting people through the butt and coming out through the mouth. Isn't this too cruel?"
"A cruel hammer."
"Didn't you see the words on his body? [Hehuan Sect Demon Cultivator]."
"Isn't our resettlement area blocked? How did the people from the Hehuan Sect enter the resettlement area?"
"All I want to know now is who did it?"
"Based on the remaining spiritual power, the Hehuan Sect's demon cultivator should be half-step in foundation-building cultivation. Who killed him? Who has the ability to kill him?"
"Is it possible that there are still peerless masters hiding in our settlement area?"
title_en: Chapter 13: Xie Jian is crazy and the secret can’t be hidden. Chapter 14: Murder and arson, gold belt tied with paper becomes spirit
